title: Whirlpool refrigerator ice maker not working — checks and likely causes

questions.ask: Do you have water dispensing normally from the door (if your model has a dispenser)? (yes/no)
Is the ice maker switch or shutoff arm turned ON and not stuck in the OFF position? (yes/no)
Is the freezer temperature around 0°F to 5°F (-18°C to -15°C)? (yes/no/unsure)

checks: Confirm the ice maker is turned ON and the shutoff arm is down.
Verify the freezer temperature is cold enough for ice production.
Check that the water supply line is turned on and not kinked.
Inspect or replace the water filter if it is overdue.
Look for a frozen fill tube blocking water entry.
If no water fills and all else checks out, the water inlet valve may be failing.

likely_parts.reason: Water inlet valve may not be opening

title: Dishwasher making a grinding or loud noise — checks and likely causes

questions.ask: Does the noise happen constantly during the wash cycle? (yes/no)
Are all dishes and utensils clear of the spray arms (nothing blocking them)? (yes/no)
Does the dishwasher drain normally at the end of the cycle? (yes/no/unsure)

checks: Check that no utensils or dishes are hitting the spray arms.
Inspect the dishwasher filter for debris or broken glass.
Listen for noise during draining, which may indicate a failing drain pump.
Grinding during wash may indicate a worn circulation pump.
If noise worsens over time, internal pump bearings may be failing.

likely_parts.reason: Circulation pump bearings can cause grinding noise
Drain pump can grind if obstructed or worn

title: Refrigerator humming or buzzing noise — checks and likely causes

questions.ask: Does the noise seem to come from the back or bottom of the refrigerator? (yes/no)
Does your refrigerator have an ice maker? (yes/no)

checks: Ensure the refrigerator is level and not vibrating against cabinets.
Clean the condenser fan and coils if dusty.
Buzzing near the back can indicate a failing condenser fan motor.
Intermittent buzzing may be caused by the ice maker water inlet valve.

likely_parts.reason: Evaporator or condenser fan motor may be noisy
Water inlet valve can buzz when failing
